prompt: Create ONE vertical 2:3 full-body character illustration for the Sekigahara Ranbu player selection screen: Ishida Mitsunari. Follow this established character design: a lean, stern Japanese commander, long black hair beneath a tall helmet bearing a broad gold folding-fan crest, dark iron and muted gold armor, ivory sleeves, richly patterned purple over-robe, restrained fan-and-flower motifs, narrow calculating eyes, fine moustache and short pointed goatee. Keep the fan-shaped crest recognizable and avoid invented writing. He stands in a composed battle-ready three-quarter pose facing right, full helmet to both sandals visible, a closed black-and-gold war fan held low in his left hand. Strong dignified silhouette, sober and elegant. Render as polished 2D Japanese historical action-game key art: expressive inked contour lines, painterly cel shading, controlled textured brush highlights, clear color blocks, deliberate graphic shapes; match a classic illustrated sprite sheet, not a photo, 3D render, or realistic photograph. Place the whole figure centered and entirely inside the frame with at least 6 percent plain background around helmet, sleeves, robe and feet. Flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background, no cast shadow. One figure only, no text, labels, calligraphy, seal, frame, scenery, glow, extra weapons, or extra characters. Readable when reduced to a 512x768 game portrait.
